description: This source file appears to be a PHP class definition for an OpenCart admin controller handling GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) related functionalities such as listing GDPR requests, approving, denying, and deleting GDPR data. It includes methods for displaying GDPR lists, processing approval/denial actions, and managing GDPR records. The file is part of the Opencart admin controllers for customer GDPR operations.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for GDPR management within the customer module of the OpenCart admin system. Handles listing, approval, denial, and deletion of GDPR records.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display GDPR overview page, including breadcrumbs and view rendering.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the listing of GDPR records, with filtering, pagination, and data fetching.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns an HTML view of the GDPR list, applying filters and pagination.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles the approval of GDPR requests, updating statuses and returning JSON response.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles the denial of GDPR requests, updating statuses and returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of GDPR requests, updating records and returning JSON response.
